scientific.integrity: All algebraic premises were reconstructed from the published vector field and replayed with exact symbolic and rational arithmetic. The introducing full text was inspected directly at the defining equations and the disputed equilibrium and characteristic-polynomial formulas.
limitations: The result is an exact equilibrium and local-spectrum correction; it does not classify global attractors or validate numerical Lyapunov exponents.

Literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed later correction or commentary, and two earlier Qi-lineage papers were compared through indexed abstracts and bibliographic descriptions rather than complete full text.

title: Corrected equilibria and local spectrum of the Cui–Li four-dimensional flow
